name: Merchant Support Advisor (Shopify, Canada)
summary: Shopify, a Canadian ecommerce platform that works remotely, hires Merchant Support Advisors in Canada to help store owners with their Shopify shops.
whatYouDo: You help merchants (business owners using Shopify) solve problems with their online stores and accounts. One posted variant is an overnight rotating shift covering weekends and holidays.
appeal: Shopify describes itself as a fully remote company
Support work on a well-known Canadian tech platform can lead to other tech/support roles
watchOuts: Overnight posting: 1-year fixed-term contract (may extend or convert), ~40 h/week rotating, starts 9–11 pm local time, incl. weekends and holidays
Must already be legally eligible to work in Canada; no visa support
Shopify has repeatedly cut support staff (reported Jan 2025, Nov 2025, Apr 2026) and uses outsourced vendors
Fake 'Shopify' part-time job offers circulate; only offers from Shopify's careers site are genuine
Pay range here is an aggregator estimate, not an official figure

compensation.notes: Indeed salary estimate for Shopify 'Support Advisor' in Canada: average ~$46,917/yr, range $28k–$71k, from 8 postings (updated Mar 2026). Not specific to overnight role.

reliability.notes: Salaried/fixed-term roles, but support headcount has been cut several times in 2025–2026 per journalism.

applicationSteps: Open shopify.com/careers and filter for support roles in Canada
Apply only through Shopify's own careers site
Confirm schedule (overnight vs. day) and contract length on the posting
fitsIf: You are already authorized to work in Canada, comfortable with tech, and want a support job at a tech company (overnight shifts OK for one variant).
notFitIf: You need job security, daytime-only hours on the overnight variant, or visa sponsorship.
